ache.title: Revenue charts: a scoreboard made of wallets
ache.note: Nero reads Sensor Tower numbers like sports scores: Star Rail tops September, Love and Deep Space surges, Wuthering Waves and Solo Leveling dip. Every ‘gain’ on that chart is players spending, and a ‘decline’ often means a studio pushes harder to win it back. Cheering revenue is cheering the meter, not the players.
watch: a game’s worth measured in earnings
ache.tip: Judge a game by how you feel after playing it, not by how much it earned last month.
lines: every bar on that chart was someone’s money
top earner isn’t the same as top game

videoData.title: Sensor Tower Gacha Revenue Analysis: September 2024

textData.text: In this video, I explore the latest Sensor Tower market analysis for gacha games comparing September and August 2024 earnings. Honkai: Star Rail tops the list with significant gains, while Love and Deep Space surprises by capturing the Chinese market. Notable mentions include Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero, both performing well. However, games like Wuthering Waves and Solo Leveling: Arise see declines, while Sword of Convallaria and Hatsune Miku Colorful Stage face challenges. Join me, Nero Atlas, in discussing these trends and insights about the gacha game landscape.
